data.name: Breaker of Kings
data.detailed_description:
Kings are more trouble than they're worth.

They take and take, send innocents off to war, and leave almost nothing untouched by their greed and their lust for power and control.

It is time to end all of that.

Gather and equip groups of adventurers and explore procedurally-generated dungeons to build their skills and find better equipment. Manage your town and prepare your adventurers for an assault on nearby castles to overthrow the useless kings once and for all while defending against invading monsters and marauding knights.

This game combines classic old-school roguelike dungeon crawling with strategic city management. It was inspired by Heroes of a Broken Land and adds the additional dimension of enemy factions.

data.short_description: Breaker of Kings is a roguelike first-person party-based dungeon crawler with strategy elements. Train up your adventurers and build your towns in order to overthrow the useless kings and free their people.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil
